chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, raising it, said, Al-Reza (peace be upon him) said:
Igniting the lantern before the sun sets negates poverty.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual or practical benefit of lighting the lamp before sunset according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) links the practical act of lighting the lamp before sunset to the alleviation of poverty, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *sunnah* practices that bring *barakah* (blessing) into the home. This narration, found in *Al-Kafi*, underscores the spiritual and material benefits of preparedness and maintaining light in the household as a means of attracting divine sustenance.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, raising it, said, 
‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Igniting the lantern before the sun sets negates the poverty’.
en.sarwar: 13. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Turning on the lamp before sunset banishes poverty.’”
